settings.save_contract: Sentinel-guarded merge. The view emits hidden bpjm_tab_rendered_keys[] / bpjm_array_rendered_keys[] listing every bool/array key it renders, so an unchecked checkbox (absent from $_POST) is an explicit 'off' (key unset) rather than 'untouched'. Preserves the legacy 'key present => yes, absent => off' contract that Bp_Job_Manager_Globals reads via array_key_exists(). Leftover scalar keys route through the legacy Bp_Job_Manager_Admin::bpjm_sanitize_settings() (admin/class-bp-job-manager-admin.php:327) so the text-field contract has one home.

coverage_notes: DEPENDENCY TRUTH: the plugin HARD-requires only BuddyPress + WP Job Manager. The gate at bp-job-manager.php:109 checks only class_exists('BuddyPress') / class_exists('WP_Job_Manager'), and the header 'Requires Plugins: buddypress, wp-job-manager' matches. Applications, Resume Manager, Bookmarks and Alerts are OPTIONAL add-ons, each detected at runtime via get_option('active_plugins') and each gating one nav/notification surface. Do NOT record them as required.

DECOUPLED (post-2.8.5): the setting bpjm_resume_at_profile now controls DISPLAY ONLY, matching its label. Registration of the Resumes nav (bp_setup_nav -> bpjm_member_profile_resumes_tab) depends solely on WP Job Manager Resume Manager being active. Display is enforced independently inside bpjm_bp_profile_field_item() (public/class-bp-job-manager-public.php:1244, :1252) and bpjm_resume_settings_before_submit() (:1324). The Youzify visibility-menu branch remains gated on the setting, which is correct — that menu IS the resume display control.

ACTIVITY WRITES USE transition_post_status, NOT the WPJM publish_job_listing / publish_resume hooks. includes/class-bp-job-manager.php hooks transition_post_status -> bpjm_publish_job_listing / bpjm_publish_resume (admin/class-bp-job-manager-admin.php:216, :241), which self-filter to the publish transition. The docblock at admin/class-bp-job-manager-admin.php now names transition_post_status correctly.

NEW IN 2.8.5: activity auto-cleanup. bpjm_delete_job_activity (admin/class-bp-job-manager-admin.php:297-319) is wired to wp_trash_post + before_delete_post (includes/class-bp-job-manager.php:201-202) so a trashed or permanently deleted job/resume never leaves a dead-link activity in the stream.

BP_Job_Manager_Feedback (admin/class-bp-job-manager-admin-feedback.php) is SELF-INSTANTIATING at :317 when the file is required (includes/class-bp-job-manager.php:139) — it is not wired through Bp_Job_Manager_Loader and registers its own admin_init hooks at :76-77. The review nag renders via admin_notices (:146-163, :272-291) and dismisses at :302-313. Note the class name is BP_Job_Manager_Feedback, which matches neither the Bp_Job_Manager_* prefix used everywhere else nor its own file name.

GUEST PSEUDO-ROLE: 'guest' is not a WP role. bpjm_restrict_user_post_job (public/class-bp-job-manager-public.php:1739-1742) treats a logged-OUT visitor as allowed to post when 'guest' is present in post_job_user_roles.

The 2.8.5 admin rebuild DELETED admin/wbcom/ (class Wbcom_Admin_Settings), admin/includes/, admin/css/, admin/js/ and admin/fonts/. Everything those directories supplied — the wbcom_admin_setting_header shortcode, the wbcom_addons_cards AJAX action, the Our Plugins / Our Themes / Support pages, the wbcom_add_header_menu and wbcom_add_plugin_license_code extension slots, selectize and FontAwesome — is GONE. The admin surface is now ONE page with 4 tabs, styled by assets/css/admin.css + assets/js/admin.js.
Admin wrapper classification: NEW (card-panel). includes/admin/views/shell.php EXISTS. The OLD-wrapper migration is DONE as of 2.8.5.
The filter bp_activity_new_job_post_action recorded by the 2026-06-05 manifest is NOT fired anywhere in the shipped code and has been removed from hooks_fired. It is not a public contract.
